scope.surface: Non-empty icon-set preview, docked search and position restoration
scope.flutterState: A 40-item icon set in dark theme; searching for 37 shows only icon 37 and clearing search returns to the gallery.
scope.kotlinVisualState: A matching 40-item fixture for grid parity and search screenshots.
scope.kotlinBehaviorFixture: An 80-item fixture forces a real scroll to icon 60 before filtering, then checks the result column and restored item coordinates.
checks: Compare the five-column gallery, title/back control, tile fallback glyph, labels and bottom search placement.
Filter the scrolled list to icon 37; the result is the only visible match, is in the first column and remains above the docked search bar.
Clear the query and verify icon 60 returns to its original vertical coordinate within 1 px while icon 0 stays off-screen.
Verify the non-empty gallery and group-picker names and selection in both themes.
scope.productionNavigationHost: Isolated Compose test Activity; the MainActivity route was not used for these captures.
productChanges: Match the Flutter gallery density with a fixed column count derived from the available width.
Use the gallery-photo placeholder glyph when an icon has no URL.
Recreate the grid content layer when search enters or exits so filtered pixels do not retain the previous visible rows.
Keep the bottom search control and restore the pre-search LazyGrid anchor.

screenshots.result: The dark 40-item grid, tile sizing, fallback art, title and bottom search placement closely match. The filtered state shows only icon 37 in the first column; the Kotlin 80-item test restores the prior scrolled position after clearing.

limits: The Kotlin captures use an isolated Compose test Activity, not an end-to-end MainActivity route or Room-backed production icon source.
The Flutter comparison host uses a source copy without Git metadata, so its exact upstream commit cannot be independently verified; it ran Flutter 3.50.0 while the repository CI pins 3.47.6.
The visual comparison covers the dark 40-item fixture and query 37; it does not establish all themes, live remote icon loading, the full app navigation stack or complete page transitions.
